answer: Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for each extra identity, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Because the terrace weight is recomputed from the ripple history each close, the anchor audit publishes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 4 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 39% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
